story.title: Orlando trucking owner pleads guilty in $1M USPS Freight Auction fraud
story.sum: Khayyam Arif Oglu Farajov, 40, owner of Talishco LLC in Orlando, pleaded guilty to one wire fraud count and one money laundering count, federal prosecutors announced Friday. DOJ said he falsely marked USPS Freight Auction shipments as delivered and collected more than $1 million. He agreed to forfeit two seized brokerage accounts and pay $993,979 in restitution, and the court has not scheduled sentencing.
story.plain: No change to USPS rates or service. The case concerns payments to a supplier in the USPS Freight Auction bulk-mail trucking program.
story.tie: DOJ announced the indictment in March 2026, and a 2024 federal audit of USPS Freight Auction proof-of-delivery controls covered the same period as the scheme.
